title: A noncomputable language in polynomial circuit size
statement: There is a language $L$ of Boolean strings contained in the language of all-ones strings such that $L$ is recognized by a family of well-formed Boolean circuits with at most two inputs per gate and size bounded by a polynomial in the input length, but membership in $L$ is not a computable predicate.
